title: Daily NK — 'Bridge over troubled waters'
snippet: Analysis of the strategic implications of the Russia-North Korea Tumen River bridge opening on June 19. The bridge represents the first-ever direct road connection between the two countries. Capacity: 300 vehicles, 2,850 people daily. Russia invested $40M in checkpoint alone. Analysis of military logistics potential, economic cooperation dimensions, and geopolitical leverage over China.
tag_reason: 6/14 Korea Herald 교량 연결 기념식 보도의 후속 심층분석. 전략적 함의, 군사물류 잠재력, 대중 레버리지 등 새로운 분석적 관점 추가.
